svg.title: Flock on Harbor — revision F
svg.desc: Proposed architecture following shepherd's Trial contract. Flock steers the swarm and keeps it healthy. Harbor owns each agent's execution: task environment, agent integration, uploaded tools, verifier and trial results. Task files are recipes; a Trial runs one task for one agent. Shared world and board services are resources, outside the task. Repeated prompting and resume remain under validation.
svg.text: FLOCK STEERS. HARBOR RUNS THE AGENT.
ONE RUN SPEC / TEAM PROMPTS / ROLES
PROMPTS / WAKE-UPS / LOOPS / HEALTH / RESTART COORDINATION
ONE TRIAL PER AGENT / SAME TASK CONTRACT AS SHEPHERD
HARBOR BUILDS / STARTS / PREPARES / CLEANS UP
REPEATED PROMPTS IN ONE TRIAL: SPIKE RUNNING.
RESUME + SESSION RESTORE + BUDGET ENFORCEMENT: STILL TO VALIDATE.
HF SANDBOX: ONE HF JOB / TRIAL
PROPOSED PORT / SHEPHERD@F3970BC / BOARD 1155-1169 / SOLID: CALLS + CONTROL / DASHED: OBSERVATIONS
